items.text: Choosing an Azure Partner Is Harder Than the Sales Deck Suggests
Most enterprises don't struggle with Azure because of the technology — they struggle because of who they hired to deliver it.
Generalist Agencies Without Microsoft Depth

Digital agencies that added "cloud" to their service list rarely carry the certifications or delivery hours to back it up, so architecture decisions default to whatever ships fastest, not what scales.
Work Quietly Subcontracted Offshore
Some partners sell a senior team in the pitch, then hand delivery to a subcontracted bench you never meet and can't vet — ownership, quality, and communication all slip.
Vendor Lock-In by Design
Proprietary frameworks, undocumented configurations, and code you don't fully own leave you dependent on the same vendor for every future change, whether you're happy with them or not.
Support That Ends at Go-Live
Many engagements are scoped to the launch date. Once the invoice is paid, tickets queue for days and the people who built your environment have moved on to the next client.

Every engagement runs on the same operating model, regardless of company size or industry.

Delivery is staffed from our own bench of Microsoft-certified architects and engineers — no undisclosed subcontractors.

items.text: Real Results, Real Impact
Frequently Asked Questions
Objection-handling answers about hiring Folio3 as your Azure partner.

Folio3 is a Microsoft Solutions Partner with Azure delivery as a core practice, not an add-on service. Architecture, migration, and DevOps work is staffed from in-house, Microsoft-certified engineers rather than generalists picking up cloud work between other projects.

No. Every engineer assigned to your account is a Folio3 employee you can meet and vet before the engagement starts, and that team stays consistent through delivery — we don't route work to an undisclosed subcontracted bench.

You own it. Every engagement includes full IP ownership, documentation, and a formal knowledge-transfer handover, so your team can operate and extend the environment independently of Folio3 if you choose to.
Engagements are scoped and priced against defined milestones and deliverables, not open-ended time and materials, so you know the budget and timeline before work begins.
No. Post-launch support is handled by named engineers who already know your environment from delivery, available through optional managed-services agreements — not a shared, anonymous ticket queue.

Yes. We commonly work as an extension of an existing IT or development team, taking on the Azure-specific architecture, migration, or DevOps work your team doesn't have the bandwidth or certifications to own alone.

Folio3 holds Microsoft Solutions Partner designations across Azure Infrastructure, Data & AI, and Digital & App Innovation, backed by 200+ Microsoft-certified engineers — verifiable directly through Microsoft's Partner Center, not self-reported credentials.

Most clients start with a scoped assessment or a fixed-fee pilot engagement against one workload, which gives you a working deliverable and a clear view of how we operate before committing to a larger engagement.
